list.title: Prospect audits
list.description: Analyze a potential client’s website, social channels and competitors before the first meeting. The AI proposes, you decide what goes into the report.
list.empty: No prospects yet. Add the first one to start an audit.
list.caption: Prospects and audit status

new.title: New prospect
new.description: The audit needs this data: website, sector, area and goals. Social profiles are kept as links only: Forgecy does not read them automatically.

policy.label: AI policy
policy.changedCancelled: Policy changed: {count, plural, one {# waiting AI step cancelled} other {# waiting AI steps cancelled}}.

deleteProspect.label: Delete the prospect and all collected data (screenshots and files included). Type {name} to confirm.

reportReview.ownSubmission: You submitted this version yourself: approving it requires a note for the log.

prospectForm.name: Name
prospectForm.websiteHint: Forgecy reads up to {max} public pages, respecting robots.txt.
prospectForm.duplicates: A similar prospect or client already exists: <list></list>. You can continue anyway.
prospectForm.notesPlaceholder: What you already know: contact, needs, competitors they mentioned…
prospectForm.socialHint: Only the profile link. Data is added later with screenshots, CSV/XLSX exports or values entered by hand.
prospectForm.aiPolicyFixed: {policy}. Only an Admin can change it.

finding.title: Title
finding.acceptObservationFirst: Accept at least one observation first.

comparisonRow.noteRequired: Note (required if you change the outcome)

competitors.title: Competitor list
competitors.skipped: You chose to continue without competitors: the report will not have this section.
competitors.confirmed: List confirmed on {date}. Up to {pages} pages are read from each website: home, services and contacts.
competitors.intro: Up to {max} direct competitors. The AI’s proposals need checking: confirm the list when it is right.
competitors.emptyAi: No competitors yet. The Strategist proposes them after the website is read, or add them yourself.
competitors.confirmListQuestion: Confirm the list? Proposals still open become confirmed and their websites are read.
competitors.sideBySideDescription: Offer and tone read on the pages; the sentence is quoted word for word.
competitors.sideBySideCaption: Offer and tone of the prospect and competitors
competitors.observationsAfterRead: Observations arrive after the competitors’ websites are read.
competitors.confirmToStart: Confirm the list to start the comparison.

comparison.title: Website, Instagram and Facebook compared
comparison.description: Five criteria: color, tone, call to action, audience and visual style. Every outcome is a proposal: if you change it, write why.
comparison.needTwoChannels: Data from at least two channels is needed: read the website or import the social data.
comparison.noAi: This prospect’s policy does not allow AI: write the comparison as an “Across channels” observation in the diagnosis.

diagnosis.title: Main problems
diagnosis.description: From {min} to {max} problems, each linked to the accepted observations that prove it. The order is the one used in the report.
diagnosis.counts: {observations, plural, one {# usable observation} other {# usable observations}} · {problems, plural, one {# accepted problem} other {# accepted problems}}
diagnosis.outdated: The observations changed after the last diagnosis: problems marked “To recheck” need reviewing.
diagnosis.withoutEvidence: Rejected because not linked to accepted observations: {count} of {proposed, plural, one {# problem proposed} other {# problems proposed}} by the last diagnosis.
diagnosis.replaceConfirm: Proposed problems not yet reviewed will be replaced. Continue?
diagnosis.needObservation: Accept at least one observation on the website, social channels or competitors to request the diagnosis.
diagnosis.noAi: This prospect’s policy does not allow AI: write the problems yourself, linking them to the accepted observations.
diagnosis.noUsable: No usable problems from the last diagnosis. You can update it or write the problems yourself.
diagnosis.noneProposed: The last diagnosis proposed no problems. You can update it or write the problems yourself.

plan.title: 30-day plan
plan.description: A proposal of pillars and content that addresses the accepted problems. It stays a proposal until you accept it.
plan.replaceConfirm: The current plan will be replaced. Continue?
plan.needProblem: Accept at least one problem to request the plan.
plan.caption: Calendar of proposed content

readiness.staleDetail: {count, plural, one {# problem to recheck} other {# problems to recheck}}

report.title: Report
report.intro: The report gathers the problems, the accepted observations and the next steps. You compose it here, send it to review and export it as a PDF after a person approves it.
report.composeAiHint: The Strategist and the Copywriter propose the texts and the email: you check them before the review.
report.completeSteps: Complete the steps above to compose the report.
report.outdated: The observations changed after the report was composed: check items and texts.
report.proposeTextsConfirm: The Strategist and the Copywriter rewrite the texts not edited by hand and the email. Continue?
report.lockedInReview: This version can no longer be edited: withdraw it from review to change it.
report.locked: This version can no longer be edited.
report.noCoverEmail: No cover email in this version.
report.pdfDescription: The PDF uses the “Audit report” template. The Strategy Presentation adds the proposed Brand Identity and Content Strategy to the diagnosis. Proofs carry the “Draft” watermark; final PDFs are exported after approval.
report.exportFailed: The last PDF was not created.
report.exportFailedWithError: The last PDF was not created: {error}
report.finalConfirm: The final PDF delivers the audit: after that it can no longer be edited. Continue?
report.evidenceDescription: Every included item must have a source that still exists.
report.evidenceOk: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}, all with evidence

evidenceReason.no_linked_observation: No linked observation is included in the report
evidenceReason.screenshot_removed: Screenshot removed from the Social Audit
evidenceReason.source_removed: The cited source no longer exists

warningMessage.empty: Section with no text or items

editor.title: Title
editor.methodHint: The method section lists the sources used on its own: channels, pages read, competitors and plan.
editor.noEmailClient: Forgecy does not send emails: copy the text into your email client.
editor.emailEmpty: Forgecy does not send emails: copy the text into your email client. Still empty: write it here or use “Propose texts with AI”, which also drafts the email.
editor.subject: Subject
editor.copyFailed: Copy failed: select the text by hand.

policy.external_restricted: External AI restricted to approved providers
policy.no_ai: No AI: observations and diagnosis are filled in by hand

overview.convertConfirm: {name} becomes an active client. The audit, sources and accepted observations stay linked. No proposal becomes official without a person’s approval.
overview.convertAfterDelivery: Available after the report is delivered.

start.title: Start the audit
start.lastAudit: The last audit is {status}. You can start a new one.
start.intro: Here is what happens when you start it. You can stop every step.

steps.websiteScan: Website scan: up to {pages} pages, with desktop and mobile screenshots
steps.noWebsite: No website given: the website scan is skipped
steps.social: Social: only data you upload (screenshots, CSV/XLSX exports, values by hand)
steps.competitorsAi: Competitors: AI proposes up to {max}, you confirm the list
steps.competitorsManual: Competitors: you add them (AI turned off by the policy)
steps.findingsAi: Observations, comparison and diagnosis proposed by AI, always to be reviewed
steps.findingsManual: Observations and diagnosis filled in by hand

start.budgetBlocked: The remaining budget is not enough for the audit. An Admin can raise it in the settings.

next.title: Next steps
next.review: Review {count, plural, one {# proposed observation} other {# proposed observations}}

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Started on {date}. Social channels are not read automatically: you upload screenshots, exports or values.

overview.archiveAuditConfirm: Archive this audit? The data stays available and you can start a new one.

converted.title: Now a client
converted.description: The audit of {name} is kept as history: the report stays readable, the prospect controls are gone.

scan.discovery: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} to read (maximum {max})
scan.screenshots: {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} read · {shots, plural, one {# screenshot} other {# screenshots}}
scan.extraction: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} analyzed
scan.analysisNoAi: AI not allowed by the policy: observations by hand
scan.analysisDone: {count, plural, one {# observation} other {# observations}} to review
scan.analysisDoneDropped: {count, plural, one {# observation} other {# observations}} to review ({dropped} rejected for lack of verifiable evidence)

h1.label: One H1 heading per page
h1.failed: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} without an H1

multiple_h1.label: A single H1
multiple_h1.failed: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} with more than one H1
multiple_h1.ok: No page with more than one H1

meta_description.label: Meta description
meta_description.failed: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} without a meta description

img_alt.label: Image alt text
img_alt.detail: {missing} of {total} images without an alt attribute

lang.label: Page language declared
lang.failed: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} without a lang attribute

viewport.label: Mobile-friendly pages (meta viewport)
viewport.failed: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} without a meta viewport

load_time.label: Loads in under 4 seconds
load_time.failed: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} over 4 s (measured from the Forgecy server)
load_time.ok: All under 4 s (measured from the Forgecy server)

structured_data.label: Business described in structured data
structured_data.failed: No page describes the business in structured data (Organization or LocalBusiness, JSON-LD)
structured_data.ok: {count, plural, one {# page describes} other {# pages describe}} the business in structured data

ai_crawlers.label: Open to AI answer engines
ai_crawlers.failed: robots.txt blocks {bots}: their answer engines cannot read the site
ai_crawlers.ok: robots.txt lets the AI answer engines read the site

errors.fileNoRows: The file has no data rows after the header.
errors.xlsxUnreadable: We cannot read the XLSX file.
errors.sheetNoRows: The sheet has no data rows after the header.
errors.mapDateColumn: Map at least the date column.
errors.auditInProgress: There is already an audit in progress for this prospect. Open or archive it before starting a new one.
errors.noWebsite: This audit has no website to read.
errors.scanInProgress: A website scan is already in progress.
errors.auditClosed: The audit is closed and can no longer be edited.
errors.policyNoAi: This prospect’s policy does not allow AI. You can fill in the sections by hand.
errors.notAProfile: The link is not a {channel} profile
errors.unavailableReasonRequired: Write why the data is not available.
errors.uploadTable: Upload a CSV or XLSX file.
errors.noValidRows: No valid rows: check the date column and the format.
errors.exactNumber: Enter an exact number, without ranges or estimates (e.g. 1,240).
errors.valueFromFile: This value comes from a file: remove the file.
errors.pagesByRescan: Website pages are updated by rescanning the website.
errors.socialInProgress: A social analysis is already in progress.
errors.socialNoData: Upload some screenshots, import an export or enter at least one value.
errors.competitorIsProspect: This is the prospect’s website, not a competitor’s.
errors.competitorDuplicate: This competitor is already in the list.
errors.competitorLimitRemove: At most {max} competitors: remove one first.
errors.removeReasonRequired: Write why you are removing it.
errors.competitorListEmpty: The list is empty: add a competitor or continue without competitors.
errors.proposalsInProgress: The proposals are already being prepared.
errors.itemConflict: Someone changed this item in the meantime. Reload to see the updated version.
errors.rejectReasonRequired: Write why you are rejecting this problem.
errors.problemLimit: The diagnosis already has {max} problems: reject one first.
errors.linkObservation: Link at least one accepted observation.
errors.linkAcceptedOnly: You can only link accepted observations.
errors.aiNotDeletable: AI proposals are rejected, not deleted.
errors.notAComparison: This is not a comparison row.
errors.outcomeNoteRequired: Write a note: the outcome differs from the proposed one.
errors.stepInProgress: This step is already in progress.
errors.twoChannels: Data is needed on at least two channels among website, Instagram and Facebook.
errors.acceptObservation: Accept at least one observation before generating the diagnosis.
errors.acceptProblem: Accept at least one problem of the diagnosis.
errors.reportInReview: The report is in review: withdraw it from review to edit it.
errors.reportLocked: This report version can no longer be edited: create a new version.
errors.reportConflict: Someone changed the report while you were working. Reload the page.
errors.auditArchivedReport: The audit is archived: reports cannot be composed.
errors.reportNotReady: Before the report: {count, plural, one {# checklist item is} other {# checklist items are}} still open.
errors.versionOpen: v{version} is still open: work on that one.
errors.policyNoAiTexts: This prospect’s policy does not allow AI: write the texts by hand.
errors.textsInProgress: The report texts are already being prepared.
errors.evidenceMissingFix: {count, plural, one {# included item has no evidence: fix or exclude it} other {# included items have no evidence: fix or exclude them}} (REPORT-EVIDENCE-MISSING).
errors.ownApprovalNote: You are approving content you submitted: add a note for the record.
errors.evidenceMissing: {count, plural, one {# included item has} other {# included items have}} no evidence (REPORT-EVIDENCE-MISSING).
errors.draftOnlyDelete: Only drafts never submitted for review can be deleted.
errors.superseded: This version was superseded by a newer one.
errors.finalNeedsApproval: The final PDF can only be exported from a version approved by a person.
errors.pdfInProgress: A PDF of the report is already being prepared.
errors.dataConflict: Someone changed this data in the meantime. Reload the page to see the updated version.
errors.prospectArchivedRestore: The prospect is archived: restore it first.
errors.confirmName: Type the exact prospect name to confirm.

jobErrors.policyNoAi: This prospect’s policy does not allow AI: fill in the section by hand.
jobErrors.policyBlocked: This prospect’s AI policy does not allow this step with the configured providers.

jobErrors.noProvider: No AI provider configured: add one in Settings or write the observations by hand.
jobErrors.providerInvalid: The AI provider did not return a valid response. Retry this step.
jobErrors.noSocialData: No data to analyze: upload screenshots, import an export or enter the values.
jobErrors.twoChannels: Data is needed on at least two channels among website, Instagram and Facebook.
jobErrors.noAcceptedObservations: No accepted observations: review the observations first.
jobErrors.acceptProblem: Accept at least one problem of the diagnosis.
jobErrors.noSocialChannel: Add at least one social channel to the prospect for the plan.
jobErrors.noLongerApproved: The version is no longer approved: the final PDF was not created.

jobErrors.templateUnfit: The published template does not fit a report: {detail}
jobErrors.reportUnfit: The report does not fit the template: {detail}

website.scanInfoRead: {url} · up to {max} public pages, robots.txt respected · read on {date}

website.observationsAfterRead: Observations arrive after the website is read.

social.intro: Read the Instagram profile, or upload screenshots as evidence, import the exports and enter values by hand with their source. A missing value stays “Unavailable”, never estimated.
social.notListed: Channel not listed for the prospect: add the link if it exists.
social.linkedinHint: LinkedIn has its own metrics and is not compared with Instagram.
social.rateHint: The engagement rate appears only with followers and interactions from the same source.

card.perWeek: {value, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} a week

reason.needsSameSource: Needs followers and interactions from the same source and period
reason.noText: No post text in the data

derived.sumPosts: Sum of {count, plural, one {# imported post} other {# imported posts}}
derived.datedPosts: {count, plural, one {# dated post} other {# dated posts}} in the last 4 weeks
derived.averagePosts: Average over {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}
derived.postsWithText: {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}} with text

social.collectedDescription: Removing a source puts the observations that cite it back to review.
social.rowsImported: {count, plural, one {# row imported} other {# rows imported}}
social.postsRead: {count, plural, one {# post read} other {# posts read}}

socialTools.screenshotsUploaded: {count, plural, one {# screenshot uploaded.} other {# screenshots uploaded.}}
socialTools.screenshots: Screenshots of the profile and posts
socialTools.screenshotsHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 20 MB each and {max} per channel. The AI uses them for style, tone and calls to action; enter the numbers you read below, with their source.

socialTools.validRowsSkipped: {count, plural, one {# valid row} other {# valid rows}} · {skipped} skipped (e.g. row {row}: invalid date). Inexact numbers (ranges, “about”) stay empty, never estimated.
socialTools.sourceNotePlaceholder: E.g. screenshot from 3 October, Meta Business Suite
socialTools.readProfileHint: Forgecy reads the public profile once and fills in followers, post count and recent posts, with the date and source. You can still enter or upload data by hand below.
socialTools.readFailed: The profile could not be read. Enter the numbers by hand or try again later.
socialTools.readUnavailable: Reading the profile needs a source set up in Settings or in the .env file. Until then, enter the numbers by hand or upload an export.
socialTools.unavailablePlaceholder: E.g. the prospect did not grant access

crawl.timeLimit: Time limit reached: pages already read were kept
crawl.stopped: Scan stopped: pages already read were kept
